whenToUse: A store launch checklist with a segmented progress rail and tasks finished inline.
Go-live gates that unlock when required setup is complete.
avoidWhen: A small getting-started card — use setup-checklist.
A linear setup wizard — use onboarding-01.
a11y: Progress is announced through aria-live / role="status"; the current segment uses aria-current.
Address fields use street-address and postal-code autocomplete.
